what: a project plugin's import of @posthog/coherence/plugin resolves to whatever copy of Coherence sits beside the plugin (the project's node_modules), not the copy that runs, so its helpers that read the registry (languageOfFile, the swaps, the slots) read an empty one and answer nothing, silently
evidence: a blind-authored C plugin's entrance rule did isCode: (file) => languageOfFile(file) === 'c'; checked by a core other than the project's node_modules copy, languageOfFile returned undefined, main.c was skipped and plugin check failed its entrances duty with 'missed src/main.c#main by main function' and no hint why; under its own copy it passed (scratchpad duties-exp/B1)

chose: a synchronous resolve hook (module.registerHooks), registered once per process in src/plugins/registry.ts (throughThisCore) the first time a plugin the project names loads, sends that plugin's imports of @posthog/coherence/plugin and @posthog/coherence/dist/plugins/api.js to the running core's own api module (api.ts or api.js beside registry, by import.meta.url), only when the importer sits in a loaded plugin's folder (as written or by its real path); called before moduleOf's import, moduleSyncOf's require and a syntax slot's require
over: refusing a plugin whose interface import resolves to another copy, naming both paths (the fallback: it would still make the adopter fix their install, while the redirect makes one copy the only answer)
a global hook over every importer (would change how a project's own non-plugin files resolve the package)
registering the hook at core startup (every hook process would pay a resolve callback even when no project plugin runs; registering on first project plugin load keeps bundled-only projects untouched)
because: the interface's helpers read module state the running core filled; one copy means one registry. registerHooks is synchronous, so it covers both the require that loads a syntax slot or moduleSyncOf and the import moduleOf does, it is available on the Node the package supports (>=22.18), and it adds one string-set lookup per resolution only in processes that load a project plugin
